commands.review_summary:
The branch adds opt-in policy doctor automatic repairs for channel ingress findings and carries lower-stack policy fix metadata, repair helpers, JSON recommendation output, and focused tests.

PR surface: Source +993, Tests +699. Total +1692 across 15 files.

Reproducibility: not applicable. this is a feature/config-repair PR rather than a reported bug. Source inspection shows current main has detect-only channel ingress checks and the PR adds repair handlers for those findings.

target.title: policy: repair channel ingress findings
target.body:
## Summary  - Stack on #99700 to add the next policy doctor repair slice. - Wire automatic repairs for channel ingress narrowing findings:   - `policy/ingress-open-groups-denied` sets reported `groupPolicy` paths to `allowlist`.   - `policy/ingress-group-mention-required` sets reported `requireMention` paths to `true`. - Keep the existing `workspaceRepairs=true` opt-in and finding fix-class gate, and only patch the exact `oc://openclaw.config/...` path emitted by policy detection.  ## Validation  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts --reporter=dot` (292 tests) - `pnpm exec oxfmt --check extensions/policy/src/doctor/automatic-repairs.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/scopes/channels.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts` - `pnpm exec oxlint extensions/policy/src/doctor/automatic-repairs.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/scopes/channels.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts` - `pnpm tsgo:extensions` - `git diff --check` - `codex review --base origin/policy-doctor-required-deny-repairs` (clean; first shorter run timed out before result)  ## Stack  - Stacked on #99700 / #99690 / #99686 / #99121. - Review after #99700, then rebase onto `main` as the lower stack lands.  ## Not Run  - `pnpm tsgo:core` remains locally blocked by unrelated untracked `src/oc-path/` unused-symbol errors in this worktree.## Real behavior proofBehavior or issue addressed:`doctor --fix` repairs channel ingress narrowing findings by setting reported `groupPolicy` paths to `allowlist` and reported `requireMention` paths to `true`, gated by `workspaceRepairs=true`.Real environment tested:Windows PowerShell in `C:\src\openclaw-fork` on the restacked policy series, top head `7aebf26a24` and this PR head `55aadf2e71`. This is a source-harness proof; it does not start a packaged OpenClaw binary or make live LLM calls.Exact steps or command run after this patch:1. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/strictness.test.ts src/flows/doctor-repair-flow.test.ts --reporter=dot`2. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.test.ts --reporter=dot`3. `pnpm tsgo:extensions`4. `pnpm lint:extensions`5. `git diff --check`
6. `node --import tsx scripts/check-policy-config-coverage.ts --check --json`Evidence after fix:The focused policy/core/CLI/tooling Vitest run passed 10 core repair-flow tests, 7 SDK surface tooling tests, 13 policy CLI tests, and 334 policy doctor/doctor-lint tests, including `repairs automatic channel ingress narrowing findings` and `does not repair channel ingress config without workspace repair opt-in`. `tsgo:extensions`, `lint:extensions`, `git diff --check`, and `node --import tsx scripts/check-policy-config-coverage.ts --check --json` all exited 0.Observed result after fix:Channel ingress repairs apply only to the exact `oc://openclaw.config/...` paths emitted by policy detection and do not run without workspace repair opt-in.What was not tested:No packaged CLI smoke, live provider run, or live LLM call was run for this source-harness proof.

Current lower stack heads:

- #99690 $(System.Collections.Hashtable[99690])
- #99700 $(System.Collections.Hashtable[99700])
- #99720 $(System.Collections.Hashtable[99720])
- #99731 $(System.Collections.Hashtable[99731])
- #99776 $(System.Collections.Hashtable[99776])

The #99686 foundation proof has been refreshed at current head to show policy check --json emits policy-owned policy.fixRecommendation, while attestation hashing uses recommendation-stripped findings. This PR includes the same foundation fix via the forward-merged stack.

Latest final-stack validation from policy-doctor-review-required-previews head $(System.Collections.Hashtable[99776]):
- 
ode scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/strictness.test.ts src/flows/doctor-repair-flow.test.ts extensions/policy/src/cli.test.ts src/commands/doctor-lint.test.ts test/scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.test.ts --reporter=dot passed: 4 shards / 367 tests.
